parts.text: I am looking for candidates interested in applying for a PhD position to reinvent the experience of collaborative authoring and delivery of presentation materials <

> (such as Keynote or Powerpoint slide decks), to be conducted in the Loki research group at (Inria / University of Lille). More details regarding the position and our group can be found on this page <

>.

I will be attending CHI 26 in Barcelona next week, so if you are interested, simply let me know by e-mail. I would be happy to discuss further.
